name: account-intel
description: Entity-centric footprint & reputation intelligence — profile a specific person, brand, or handle across X/Twitter + YouTube + the web (news + citations), with holdings context from a user-supplied associated EVM wallet, into one cross-platform footprint brief. Uses x402 via Circle Gateway and MPP on Tempo, paid per call over selat-pay (USDC via Circle Gateway), no API keys.

handle.description: X/Twitter handle (no @) to pull a profile and recent tweets for (used as ${handle}).

name.description: Display name of the person/brand/entity to search YouTube + web news + citations for (used as ${name}).

address.description: Non-zero EVM wallet or treasury address supplied by the user and associated with the entity, used to retrieve cross-chain token holdings (used as ${address}).

steps.label: X/Twitter profile — SELAT Twitter API (x402 via Circle Gateway)
X/Twitter recent tweets — SELAT Twitter API (x402 via Circle Gateway)
YouTube presence — Scrape Creators (MPP on Tempo)
Web reputation / news — Brave news-search (MPP on Tempo)
Web context / citations — Exa search (MPP on Tempo)
On-chain wallet holdings — Alchemy tokens-by-wallet (x402 via Circle Gateway)
